description:
I’d rather you call me crazy and a dreamer than someone who settled for a life of mediocrity. 

One life.

Let’s GET IT.
transcript: One life. Why aren't we running like we're on fire towards our wildest dreams? We got one shot at this. Why aren't we like the crazy one? I want people to look at me, that guy is nuts. Good, I got one shot at this life. I'd rather you call me crazy and a dreamer than a settler. You're not made to stand in line. You're made to stand out.
